My cosy room

Your room again! Cosy things, in, on and under, there is and there are, and a cat that hides. Finish a part and get a sticker. Press the speaker to hear any words.

¡Tu habitación otra vez! Cosas acogedoras (cosy), en y debajo de, “hay”, y un gato que se esconde. Pulsa el altavoz para escuchar.
    1

    Show me your room!

    Show Alena your drawing of your room. Then open a card, listen and answer.

    Enseña a Alena tu dibujo de tu habitación. Luego abre una tarjeta, escucha y contesta.
    2

    Room words again

    Do you remember? Tap a picture and say the word. Then press Play: listen and tap the right picture.

    ¿Te acuerdas? Toca una imagen y di la palabra. Luego pulsa Play: escucha y toca la imagen correcta.

    3

    Cosy things

    Cosy means warm and nice. Here are six cosy things. Tap a picture, listen and say it. Then press Play.

    “Cosy” es acogedor, cálido. Seis cosas nuevas: toca, escucha y dilo. Luego pulsa Play.

    4

    In, on, under

    Where is the cat? Look at the picture and tap the right sentence.

    ¿Dónde está el gato? Mira la imagen y toca la frase correcta.
    inen, dentro de

    The cat is in the box.

    onen, encima de

    The cat is on the bed.

    underdebajo de

    The cat is under the table.

      5

      There is, there are

      One thing: there is. Many things: there are. Look at the picture, count and tap the right sentence.

      Una cosa: there is. Muchas cosas: there are. En español las dos son “hay”. Mira, cuenta y toca la frase correcta.
      There is …hay (una cosa)

      There is a clock. There is a plant.

      There are …hay (muchas cosas)

      There are two pillows. There are three candles.

        6

        The sound th

        A new sound: th. Put your tongue between your teeth and blow: three, thank you, there. Tap a picture and listen. Then press Play.

        Un sonido nuevo: th. La lengua entre los dientes, como la z de “zapato” o la c de “gracias”. Toca y escucha. Luego pulsa Play.

        Say it with your tongue out

          7

          Listen and draw

          Listen and draw a cosy room! Press a speaker, listen and draw it here or on paper.

          ¡Escucha y dibuja una habitación acogedora! Pulsa un altavoz, escucha y dibújalo aquí o en papel.
            8

            Mia’s cosy room

            Mia is back! Read about her cosy room. Press a speaker to listen. Then answer the questions.

            ¡Mia ha vuelto! Lee sobre su habitación. Pulsa un altavoz para escuchar. Luego contesta las preguntas.
            Mia

            Hi! I’m Mia. I’m eleven.

            This is my room. It is small and cosy.

            There is a big bed. There are three pillows on the bed.

            There is a blanket on the bed. It is purple.

            There is a table and a chair.

            There are two candles on the table.

            There are four plants in my room!

            My cat is under the bed. I don’t have a TV.

              9

              Where is the cat?

              The cat is hiding! Ask: Is the cat under the bed? Then tap and look. Yes, it is! Or: No, it isn’t.

              ¡El gato se esconde! Pregunta: “Is the cat under the bed?”. Luego toca y mira.

              10

              Tell me, I draw!

              Now you are the teacher! Tell Alena about your room. Alena draws it. Is it right?

              ¡Ahora tú eres la profe! Cuéntale a Alena cómo es tu habitación. Alena la dibuja. ¿Está bien?
              Tell me!Usa estas frases.

              There is a bed. There are two windows.

              My bed is big. It is pink.

              My cat is on the bed.

              No! It is under the bed!

              11

              Homework

              Look at your stickers! And here is your homework. No writing!

              ¡Mira tus pegatinas! Y aquí tienes los deberes. ¡Sin escribir!

              1. Play “Cosy things” and “Where is the cat?” on this page again.

                Juega otra vez a estas dos partes.

              2. Hide a toy at home. Your sister or brother asks: “Is it under the bed? Is it in the box?” You say: “Yes, it is!” or “No, it isn’t!”

                Esconde un juguete en casa. Tu hermana o tu hermano pregunta en inglés, y tú contestas.

              3. Look at your room and say five sentences: “There is a bed. There are two windows.”

                Mira tu habitación y di cinco frases con “there is” y “there are”.

              4. Send Alena a voice message: “Hi Alena! In my room there is …”

                Envía un mensaje de voz a Alena sobre tu habitación.
